proposal.hook_quote: They buried Alexander Ashwin three years ago.
proposal.cliffhanger_quote: And I am bringing my wife home.
proposal.unresolved_question: Will Alexander succeed in reclaiming his house and rescuing his wife from his enemies?
proposal.new_viewer_context: A scarred Duke presumed dead for three years casts off his disguise to lead a direct assault to take back his domain and rescue his wife.
proposal.why_it_works: Pairs a powerful identity reveal with a high-stakes vow of rescue, ending right as the hero marches into battle.
